newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ dollar ends higher, supported by Aust dlr rally.
newsitem.headline: NZ dollar ends higher, supported by Aust dlr rally.

text.p: A rally in the Australian dollar lent support to its New Zealand counterpart in moderate Thursday trading, the Kiwi ending modestly firmer.
Kiwi closed at US$0.6918/25 from 0.6900/07 this morning, while the Australian dollar was at US$0.7691/96 from 0.7673/78, the latter having rallied about 50 basis points overnight.
The local currency traded a 0.6989-28 range on the day and finished slightly up on its Trade-Weighted Index at 68.74 from 68.71.
"The catalyst for the rally has been the Aussie," said one dealer. When the Kiwi reached 0.6920, exporter buying kicked in on the European crosses plus against the U.S. dollar.
"I guess they were just basically getting cover on board in case it rallies on up to 0.6950," he said.
But there was little offshore buying, apart from some limited interest out of Asia.
Longer term, the Kiwi was not expected to budge out of a 0.6850-0.6950 range over the next two or three weeks.
